name: edunext
description: EduNext — self-hosted course site that personalizes learning with on-device attention + emotion sensing.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @edunext/backend" "npm run dev -w @edunext/frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @edunext/shared && npm run test -w @edunext/backend && npm run test -w @edunext/frontend
